The resistance of resistor X is greater than the resistance of resistor Y.

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) 9.0 V and negligible internal resistance is connected
in series with a light-dependent resistor (LDR) and a fixed resistor of resistance 1800 Ω, as
shown in Fig. 6.2.
A voltmeter is connected across the fixed resistor. The reading on the voltmeter is 5.4 V.
parts.question_text_latex:
A battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) 9.0 V and negligible internal resistance is connected
in series with a light-dependent resistor (LDR) and a fixed resistor of resistance 1800 $\Omega$, as
shown in Fig. 6.2.
A voltmeter is connected across the fixed resistor. The reading on the voltmeter is 5.4 V.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the current in the circuit.
current = A

voltmeter reading.
